WITH total_members AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM member
),
major_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    major.major_id,
    major.department,
    COUNT(member.member_id) AS member_count
  FROM major
  INNER JOIN member ON major.major_id = member.link_to_major
  GROUP BY major.major_id, major.department
),
major_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    major_id,
    department,
    member_count,
    CAST(member_count AS REAL) / (SELECT total FROM total_members) AS share
  FROM major_counts
),
department_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    department,
    AVG(share) AS avg_share
  FROM major_shares
  GROUP BY department
)
SELECT 
  ms.major_id,
  ms.department,
  ms.member_count,
  ms.share,
  ms.share - da.avg_share AS difference_above_average
FROM major_shares ms
JOIN department_averages da ON ms.department = da.department
WHERE ms.share > da.avg_share
ORDER BY difference_above_average DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Members where link_to_major is NULL are excluded from major/member counting but included in the total club member count used for share calculation
